limits: Imports app.main without lifespan or database connection.
Authorizations views reuse method/path and do not increase the denominator.
TOOL entries are tracked separately and never counted as HTTP.
Prior-phase evidence is referenced, not claimed rerun.
S4 pending states are explicit until real implementation and independent tests.
Residual disposition is a design obligation; final implementation must remove dead gates/adapters and verify remaining one-way guards.
